tactics.tactic: Deploy 3-part hook within first 2 seconds: (1) AI visual showing the payoff/result (not the setup), (2) 3-7 word bold text overlay stating a result, secret, or comparison, (3) 5-10 word verbal hook. All three must reinforce the same single idea. Test 3 hook variants per week, changing only the hook while keeping content identical.
tactics.why: 50-60% of viewers drop in first 3 seconds; hooks in first 2 seconds retain 19% more viewers. 80%+ of all engagement happens in first 10 seconds.
test_ideas: Test curiosity-gap hook: 'They don't want you to know...' vs. result-first: 'Here's what 73% of parents miss...'
Test visual payoff: show end result in frame 1 vs. show process building to result
Test text overlay timing: overlay appears at 0s vs. 1s vs. 2s

tactics.tactic: Design every Short for 70%+ viewed-vs-swiped ratio and seamless looping. For <25s videos, end frame should visually match or flow into opening frame to trigger replay. For 25-35s videos, maintain 70%+ completion via rapid visual cuts every 2-4 seconds and zero dead air.
tactics.why: 70-90% viewed-vs-swiped is the top-performer band. Looping Shorts exceeding 100% avg view duration get ~30% additional distribution. 70%+ completion = ~30% more algorithmic promotion.
test_ideas: A/B test loop-friendly ending (visual rhymes with open) vs. hard cut ending
Test 15s vs 25s length for same fact to find completion-rate sweet spot
Add mid-video micro open loop at 8-10s ('But here's the surprising part...') to arrest drop-off

tactics.tactic: Add visual/audio pattern interrupt in the first 5 seconds on every video: a quick zoom, color flash, sound effect, or abrupt cut to a contrasting visual. Simultaneously ensure bold on-screen text is present throughout the full video.
tactics.why: Pattern interrupts in first 5 seconds increase retention by 23%. On-screen text overlays boost watch time by 18%. Both are trivially implementable in Remotion.
test_ideas: Test zoom-in cut at 0.5s vs. color grade shift at 1s as pattern interrupt
Test full-video caption text vs. only-hook text overlay on retention curve
Test rapid 3-image sequence in first 3s vs. single slow-pan opening image

tactics.tactic: Reformat all Short titles to front-load the niche keyword in first 20-25 characters, e.g., 'Baby fact: why newborns...' or 'AI fact: GPT-4 can...' — not 'Did you know...' or 'The truth about...'. Use 3-5 niche hashtags instead of generic #Shorts.
tactics.why: January 2026 YouTube Shorts search filter makes titles discoverable as a first-class search result. First 20-25 chars are the indexed anchor. Corroborated across Miraflow, vidIQ, and OutlierKit.
test_ideas: Test 'Baby fact: [hook]' vs. 'Did you know: [hook]' title prefix on same content
Test 3 niche hashtags vs. 5 niche hashtags on click-through rate
Test question-format title ('Why do babies...?') vs. statement format ('Babies do this because...')

tactics.tactic: Structure content output as thematic mini-series: group 3-5 Shorts on the same sub-topic (e.g., 'newborn reflexes series', 'compound interest series') published within the same week to boost session-time signals and topical authority.
tactics.why: Multiple related Shorts increase session time and algorithmic favorability. Building topical clusters signals channel authority, helping seed-audience targeting. Channels combining topical Shorts with long-form grow 41% faster.
test_ideas: Test 3-part series (published Mon/Wed/Fri same week, same sub-topic) vs. 3 independent topics
Add 'Part 1/3' indicator in title/overlay to encourage series binging
Link thematic series to corresponding long-form YouTube video for session extension
